rationale: Moved the phased rollout sequencing out of the canonical doc: deleted section 24 Rollout Guidance, renumbered Decision Summary to 24, created docs/tmp/ProviderProfileTierSettingsRollout.md with the sequencing, and added an Implementation tracking pointer so the canonical file keeps only declarative requirements and acceptance criteria.

Bound capability lookup to the selected profile: section 12.1 now specifies GET /api/v1/provider-profiles/{profile_id}/capabilities (with the runtime/provider query form reserved for advisory create-form drafts), section 12.2 adds profile_id plus an evidence block (source, credential_generation, image_ref, observed_at, stale) that the option sets are bound to, and rules 10-12 in 12.3 plus 12.4 require refetch and no new values when the profile evidence identity does not match.

Section 4.4 now states that Runtime default requires a null tier model/effort to resolve directly to the runtime default with no profile-level compatibility field in between, names removal of that step as a prerequisite owned by ProviderProfileModelEffortTiers.md, and requires the inherited value and effective preview to come from backend-reported resolution and to name a non-runtime source instead of showing Runtime default. The concrete resolver and test removals are sequenced in docs/tmp/ProviderProfileTierSettingsRollout.md Phase 2.

Section 15.2 is now Tier-only persistence: no client-side derivation, no compatibility period, and one cohesive removal of default_model/default_effort from the read and write contracts, the launch-time compatibility step, and the remaining callers, fixtures, and tests. Documented that no persisted-history cutover is required because runs persist resolved values at launch. Reconciled sections 3.3, 5, 6.3, 14.2 (14.3 removed), 18.1, 22.1, 22.5, 23.14, and the Decision Summary.
Codex review summary body with no actionable request; its individual findings are tracked as the four review comments above.
